description: Defines the URLRequestTestJob class used for unit testing URL request handling in Chromium, including static methods for test URLs, response data, headers, and control over job execution.

classes.name: URLRequestTestJob
classes.description: A mock URL request job class for unit testing, capable of returning predefined responses, headers, and simulating redirects and errors.

methods.name: URLRequestTestJob
methods.description: Constructor to create a test job with predefined response headers and data, or default responses based on URL.

methods.name: ~URLRequestTestJob
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: test_url_1
methods.description: Returns the URL for the first test case, which auto-advances.

methods.name: test_url_2
methods.description: Returns the URL for the second test case, requiring manual advancement.

methods.name: test_url_3
methods.description: Returns the URL for the third test case, requiring manual advancement.

methods.name: test_url_4
methods.description: Returns the URL for the fourth test case, requiring manual advancement.

methods.name: test_url_auto_advance_async_reads_1
methods.description: Returns a URL that automatically advances and reads asynchronously.

methods.name: test_url_error
methods.description: Returns a URL that simulates an invalid URL error.

methods.name: test_url_redirect_to_url_1
methods.description: Returns a URL that redirects to test_url_1.

methods.name: test_url_redirect_to_url_2
methods.description: Returns a URL that redirects to test_url_2.

methods.name: test_data_1
methods.description: Returns the response data for test_url_1.

methods.name: test_data_2
methods.description: Returns the response data for test_url_2.

methods.name: test_data_3
methods.description: Returns the response data for test_url_3.

methods.name: test_data_4
methods.description: Returns the response data for test_url_4.

methods.name: test_headers
methods.description: Returns headers for the test responses.

methods.name: test_redirect_headers
methods.description: Returns headers for redirect responses.

methods.name: test_redirect_to_url_1_headers
methods.description: Headers for redirecting to test_url_1.

methods.name: test_redirect_to_url_2_headers
methods.description: Headers for redirecting to test_url_2.

methods.name: test_error_headers
methods.description: Headers for error responses.

methods.name: ProcessOnePendingMessage
methods.description: Processes one pending message in the test job queue.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the test job.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins processing the test job.

methods.name: ReadRawData
methods.description: Reads raw data into buffer.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates the test job.

methods.name: GetMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type of response.

methods.name: GetResponseInfo
methods.description: Retrieves response info.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing info.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: IsRedirectResponse
methods.description: Checks if response is a redirect.

methods.name: NextReadAsync
methods.description: Determines if next read is asynchronous.

methods.name: ProcessNextOperation
methods.description: Processes the next operation in the job.

methods.name: AdvanceJob
methods.description: Advances the job to the next stage.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts asynchronous operations.

methods.name: SetResponseHeaders
methods.description: Sets response headers.

methods.name: CopyDataForRead
methods.description: Copies response data into buffer.
